A.customer: Hollowmere Logistics LLC (Ohio limited liability company)

measurement.period: calendar month (partial months pro-rated by minutes within the Subscription Term)
measurement.method: automated probes at intervals of not more than 1 minute from at least 3 geographically distinct locations; Unavailable if no successful response within 30 seconds from at least 2 locations; Availability = ((Total Minutes - Excluded Minutes - Downtime Minutes) / (Total Minutes - Excluded Minutes)) x 100, rounded to 2 decimal places

credit_tiers.condition: availability below 99.9% but at or above 99.0%

A.claim_deadline: 30 days after the last day of the Measurement Period
A.credit_delivery: applied as a credit against the next invoice for Monthly Fees; refunded within 30 days if no further invoice will be issued after expiry or termination (unless Vendor terminated for Customer's uncured material breach); otherwise no cash value
